items.headline: Haynes, Georgia Tech run for first win at Clemson since 2008 on Saturday 20-6
items.description: — Georgia Tech quarterback Alberto Mendoza knew his team was good enough to accomplish what few Yellow Jackets squads had done in recent years and win at Death Valley, no matter how much he and his teammates had struggled this season.

items.headline: Clemson QB Reynolds to have MRI on knee; backup Vizzina (ankle) also hurt
items.description: Clemson quarterback Tait Reynolds is having an MRI on his injured knee, and backup Christopher Vizzina was sent to the hospital to evaluate his ankle.
